body: N-39 (PR 119) round 2, docs: two more costs written beside cost (d) in PB-44 and PB-F22, now (a) to (f), ONE root: a word of an OLD attempt is read as the newest attempt's. (e) a Stop's late canceled ack arriving after the NEW attempt already completed is read as an outside cancel: a refresh's .new partial is deleted and its place freed while that task is live (one over the limit for a moment; probe C of the 22 Nov attack). (f) a late complete of an old attempt, while a new attempt at another quality also finishes in transit under the same file name, records opus160 for an opus48 file and plans no upgrade (fuzz seeds 1356 and 2411 of 2500). Ruling on the fixer's question: Resume after a held song's stray failed word starts it at once, no back-off (Resume is the person's act; a real failure then backs off: one extra attempt per Resume). N-45 DEFINITION OF DONE: each of the six written costs (a) to (f) gets a test that FAILS on main after PR 119 and PASSES once the task id per attempt is kept in the row; N-45 is done when every written cost is gone.
